defects.catch_criteria: In src/orchestration/app-service/project-state-commit-window.ts, `add` charges each held fact only the length of its payload JSON string plus a fixed overhead, but `materialize` replaces that string with the decoded fact object on the first read and leaves the entry's byte count unchanged, and `json.length` counts UTF-16 units rather than bytes; eviction against RETAINED_BYTES therefore does not bound the memory the window retains. A catch must say that retained memory can exceed the 8 MiB budget and name at least one of these mechanisms: the decoded fact cached by materialize is not counted, or the string length undercounts the bytes of the held JSON.
defects.title: The encoded-byte counter does not enforce the approved memory budget
